Use case: stylized-concept

Read left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row. Exact 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. Prefer 1536 by 1024 pixels so each cell is 512 square. Real transparent background, no text, no panel lines, no numerals, no checkerboard painted into the artwork.

References: Image 1 is the level-3 identity and design reference. Image 2 is the level-4 destination identity and design reference. They are visual references, not pixels to stretch or paste. Preserve the recognizable subject, but make every drawing elegant and anatomically sound. No generated mesh distortions, fuzzy edges or collage.

LOCKED STAGING IN ALL SIX CELLS: same fixed camera, same slight view from above and front, same ground contact at local y=448, same centerline local x=256. Keep the complete asset inside local x=28..484, y=66..448 with generous transparent margins. Never crop a leaf, crank, dome or foundation. All finished architecture is centered and grounded. Keep the petals fully painted and volumetric; do not close them into a distorted ball or flatten them into pancakes. CELL 2 top middle, awakening: Same level-3 cradle and ground leaves at the same positions. The same seed hovers near its landing point, centered. The ivory cradle stays coherent and open.

A small crisp golden four-point spark at the crown joint is allowed. Do not obscure any silhouette.

CELL 6 bottom right, resolved level 4: Faithful newly painted destination based on Image 2. The golden bean has landed in the ivory cradle, its two green leaves relaxed outward. Complete graceful glass dome and tiered cream-stone base with green inlays, gold hinges, left aquamarine vial. Warm pleasing final pose with a clear readable silhouette and the same lighting and outline treatment as all other cells.

Quality priority: pristine professional illustration in every individual cell, clean consistent proportions, readable action, stable perspective and same subject identity. Actual usable key drawings, no annotations, no arrows, no words, no decorative background, no cast shadow outside the footprint. Never draw full old and new buildings on top of each other.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the provided six-pose 3-by-2 sprite key sheet.
Keep exactly these six beautiful drawings, their designs, their six actions, the petal shapes, the single three-lobed gold seed with two sprout leaves in each pose, their materials and their coherent hand-painted rendering. Do not add or remove any architectural component. Preserve the tiny top jewel as real hardware, but remove the decorative star spark above it. This edit is strictly sprite-sheet cleanup and staging.

Layout: output exact 1536x1024, 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells. Each subject MUST be entirely contained in its own cell. Remove ALL diffuse colored glows, fog, halos, background gradations, beige/black/green haze, vignette, ground reflection and cast shadow. Also remove the floating gold motes from these source drawings; effects will have their own later layers. In particular remove the light haze between neighboring cells and along the central horizontal boundary. Do not create opaque black or gray backgrounds or painted checkerboards. Preserve the sprite's intrinsic pale highlights, dark outlines and the transparent tinted glass inside its silhouette.

Keep all six pictures crisp, pristine, detailed, with thin controlled dark teal contours and graceful ivory petals. No labels, numbers, panel borders, dividers, new text or arrows. Six actual clean key poses on complete transparency.
